stories.title: Chrono Odyssey: Uncut Chrono Gate Boss Fight Gameplay - IGN
stories.summary: Chrono Odyssey is an upcoming time-manipulating action-MMORPG due out in Q2 2027 for PC and consoles. This video offers a first look at Paladin battling Mirajin, a new Chrono Gate boss. It also showcases strategic combat using two key Chronotector movements, Replicate and Isolation. Paladin, unveiled for the first time, is a class that wields a long spear and shield. The footage showcases chained attacks with the spear, as well as a skill that summons a massive spear to deal damage to the boss. It also highlights Paladin using its shield to block incoming attacks and mitigate damage. Replicate allows players to temporarily recreate the combat skills of bosses they have previously defeated to attack their enemies, while Isolation freezes an enemy in time for a limited period, restricting its movement. The footage demonstrates how players can use these abilities to control enemy movements and create openings for attacks, highlighting the strategic possibilities of time manipulation in combat. Wishlist Chrono Odyssey on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873440/Chrono_Odyssey/
